title: Evidence register and next acceptance gates
summary: Qualification is recorded per layer: source validity, offline cryptographic contract, planner numeric pressure, local native UDP, persistent authenticated session, atomic durable install, ED209 raw36 and L2. Promotion requires all relevant gates with reproducible logs.
invariants: Never substitute an offline verifier test for a live gateway security test
Do not claim a full multi-hop XTP router, complete AF_XTP kernel stack or raw36/L2 promotion
Do not equate an XTP CNTL receipt to durable application ACK_APPLIED
Controller partition writes fail closed; existing valid committed leases remain usable under explicit policy
No live ED209 routing changes without independently tested emergency access and rollback
procedure: Run offline candidate tests: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v in provisioning candidate1 (19 tests)
Run planner pressure and Storage concurrent admission suites under supplied ooRexx r13196 and Werror native build
Implement and test remote cryptographic session identity, replay and cross-context confidentiality
Implement file write-before-memory, signatures/quorum and gateway atomic stage/activate/revert
Test 2-of-2 controller partition and 2-of-3 failover with actual durable replication authority
Test persistent UDP large range transfer; then ED209 raw36 using dedicated CAP_NET_RAW; L2 later
Record exact package SHA-256, commands, node identities, observed failure and rollback outcomes
